stem: Root-zone pH samples from different parts of the same container disagree consistently. What is the best response?
choices: Use whichever value is closest to the target
Standardize the sampling method and location, repeat measurements, and treat spatial variability as information rather than averaging blindly
Adjust fertilizer strength until all readings become identical
Discard all pH measurements and use EC only
rationale: Root-zone chemistry can vary spatially. Consistent sampling and repeated measurements are needed to determine whether the difference is real and relevant to the active root zone.
